query: How do I enable app notifications?

goal.title: Enable Amazon notifications on the phone
goal.description: Unlock the phone, locate Amazon in the Settings app list, open its Notifications page, enable Allow Notifications, and return to the app list.
goal.final_state: Amazon notification options are enabled and the app settings list is displayed. The phone is then locked in the unsegmented tail.
procedure: Wake and unlock the phone with the passcode keypad.
Open Settings, scroll the app list, and select Amazon.
Open Notifications and turn on Allow Notifications.
Check the enabled alert options, then return through Amazon settings to the Apps list.

phases.description: The phone is woken, swiped to the passcode screen, unlocked, and Settings opened.
The Settings list is scrolled, Amazon selected, and its Notifications row opened.
After a pause on the disabled page, Allow Notifications is switched on near t=46s. The enabled alert options remain visible before the back buttons return to Amazon settings and the Apps list.
